erik-home-intro: I'm an engineer. I like doing good work on hard problems, and I love the physics and figuring things out. I like starting with a concept, when we're still working out what it could be and how it might work. I want to understand the system well enough to test something meaningful, then use what we learn to make the compromises without losing the intent. Doing that work early gives us more room to get the important decisions right and carry them through to something we can build and use.
erik-reading-intro: Explore the products and the decisions behind them, read my resume, or follow the longer story into family, repair and the tools I'm building now.
erik-contact-intro: I'm interested in senior individual contributor work with responsibility for product architecture, technical strategy and development methods. If you're working on a hard product problem and want to talk through where I could contribute, get in touch.
bio-one-third: Erik Norris is an engineer working on product architecture, systems integration and the tools used to develop products.
